goals.description: Validate code quality, architecture health, and spec compliance against current state
Benchmark UAR against all comparable 2026 agent runtimes via live web research
Identify what users/developers are demanding in agent runtimes (blogs, LinkedIn, Medium)
Assess product-market fit — are UAR's differentiators aligned with real demand?
Produce a classified improvement plan (critical / high / medium / minor)
Write a self-contained baseline snapshot enabling measurable reassessment

prior_assessment.summary: Post Phase 1-9 internal completion audit. 109/109 tests passing, 0 clippy warnings, 15/16 spec sections implemented. A2UI runtime resolution (§06) remained the single open item.
